definitions.explanation: The cost of electricity usage, typically paid monthly.

examples.japanese: {電気代|でんきだい}が{高|たか}い。
{電気代|でんきだい}を{払|はら}う。
{夏|なつ}はエアコンを{使|つか}うから、{電気代|でんきだい}が{上|あ}がる。
examples.english: The electricity bill goes up in summer because we use the air conditioner.

notes:
A compound of {電気|でんき} (electricity) + {代|だい} (cost/charge). Refers to the monthly electricity bill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電気代|でんきだい}を{払|はら}う: to pay the electricity bill
- {電気代|でんきだい}を{節約|せつやく}する: to save on electricity costs
- {電気代|でんきだい}が{上|あ}がる/{下|さ}がる: the bill goes up/down
- {電気代|でんきだい}がかかる: electricity costs add up

SIMILAR WORDS:
{電気料金|でんきりょうきん} is the more formal/official term for electricity charges, used on bills and by utility companies. {電気代|でんきだい} is the everyday conversational form.

RELATED UTILITY COSTS:
- {水道代|すいどうだい}: water bill
- ガス{代|だい}: gas bill
- {光熱費|こうねつひ}: utility costs (electricity + gas + heating combined)
- {通信費|つうしんひ}: communication costs (phone, internet)

The 〜{代|だい} suffix is commonly used for costs: {電話代|でんわだい} (phone bill), {食事代|しょくじだい} (meal cost), {家賃|やちん} (rent, though this uses a different suffix).
